from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyMonetaryRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single company's monetary funds balance from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    monetary_funds_balance: float | None = Field(description="The monetary funds balance value at the end of the period")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting end date (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the balance (e.g., Yuan)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates monetary funds records from all provided financial reports."""
    monetary_fund_records: List[CompanyMonetaryRecord]
